Heather “helped” us reupholster our cloth seats to leather. We picked our seats with perforation on the body only of the seat. Prior to install, Heather confirmed via text the total out the door price and that we didn’t want the wings of the seats perforated. We received our vehicle back with perforated body and wings on Friday shortly after 5p (and left Heather a message upon pick up that the leather was incorrect). We contacted Heather again on Monday (since she doesn’t respond to anything if it comes in after 5p M-F) and she didn’t respond till my husband contacted her again on Wednesday. She then told him that to correct (THEIR) mistake would cost US an additional $300 because what we wanted was not in stock and would be a special order (it’s a plain Katzkin leather seat kit. Nothing fancy). When going back and forth on numbers with us earlier and confirming body perforation only, the total price DID NOT include a $300 special order fee. Plus, they auto charge 3.5% for all card transactions (and didn’t tell us there was this additional charge. Had we known, we would have just paid by check). Screen shots of conversations have been shared with Heather to show how she is now being deceitful, not owning up to her mistake, and making no effort to help us get the leather we wanted without soaking more money out of us. We have a 2nd vehicle that needs leather replaced in it but after this experience, we surely WILL NOT be using this place and have no idea how they have contracts in place with places like James Wood Cadillac/Chevy/Buick in Denton and Huffines Subaru in Corinth. Buyer beware is my advice.
